title: Notice of Intent to Award a BPA Call Order
agency_path: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.FOREST SERVICE.USDA-FS, CSA EAST 13
detail_text: THIS IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. (this is NOT a solicitation) This is a notice of intent to award a competitive BPA Call Order against the Forest Service – Region 9 Roads Blanket Purchase Agreements for Zone 14 in the Superior National Forest. (Only contractors with an active BPA for the respective zone will be eligible for this call order.) Work includes but is not limited to: replacement of 2 culverts, and associated road repairs.
